Class MessageSource

java.lang.Object
com.github.copilot.rpc.MessageSource
public final class MessageSource extends Object
The origin of a message sent to a Copilot session.

Set on MessageOptions.setSource(MessageSource) to distinguish user input, system context, and messages from identified agents. This does not configure the session's system prompt or change the message delivery mode.
